subset_method: Retain every source row whose word occurs in known_pool.txt; keep its original count. No rank cutoff, repeat-letter filter, or blocklist is applied to this source snapshot.
known_pool_source: Supplied WordSet data/known_pool.txt; lowercase five-letter entries from the included SCOWL/ESDB size-60 US export.
blocklist_source: Supplied WordSet lists/answer_blocklist.txt, adapted in that project from LDNOOBW and manual exclusions.
plural_subset_method: Parse noun (<n>) source lines using the matching libscowl._core._matchLine, parseLemmaPart, and Line.procWords functions. Retain ns/nss forms occurring in known_pool.txt, at all ESDB sizes. Include same-spelling singular/plural forms and ambiguous homographs. Match each plural to the explicit lemma with the same Spellings.key() and variant number within its blank-line-delimited group, regardless of row order. Record source line and lemma. The complete plural snapshot is independent of target-selection policy.
